title: KAITO — Strumming Supporter〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, if this day seems good for our shoot, I'll go ahead and book the studio for us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We only have a limited number of days to practice, so we need to make the most of each session.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, let's do our best to make the best music video ever!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I can't wait to see it♪
Right, Miku-P, KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It actually sounds really fun to set up your own channel and post your own videos.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it does...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! How should we do the “like and subscribe” part for the end of our video?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wouldn't a simple caption be enough?
I kind of don't want to ruin the atmosphere that the song creates.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. I'll be sure to look up how to do that while learning how to edit videos.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Setting up a channel...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (The others told me about how a huge number of people are very active posting videos online...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, um...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Being here for these sorts of moments is always kind of interesting.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For these sorts of moments...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When the girls decide to start something new or take on a tough challenge.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm only able to watch over them, but for some reason, I feel very anxious...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Doesn't that mean you're worried?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That may be so.
But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, wanna ask a real cameraperson to do the shoot for us? I bet our video would turn out amazing if Kohane were behind the camera.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's a great photographer, but I'm not sure if videos are really her thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, more than anything, we need to focus on putting on a good performance.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This sensation...
I think I'm more excited than anxious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, I probably shouldn't feel worried when the girls are all very much looking forward to embarking on their new endeavor.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure they'll achieve a wonderful result.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
Especially considering how much they've overcome already!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(I want to give the girls my full support.
But how do I actually do that...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh, I know...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This phrase...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You really are something else, KAITO.
Can you tell us what was going through your mind while you were playing that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wanted you all to see a new door opening in front of you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A new door...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean you were trying to cheer us on?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it certainly did have that feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that the phrase we heard when KAITO was being introduced to us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
KAITO!
This means you're trying to cheer for us, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes...
I can't quite put it into words...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I hope that worked.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it definitely did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That's good to hear...
